entities.summary: Sevdalin Minchev Angelov is a retired male weightlifter from Bulgaria. He is a four-time Olympian. Minchev is a 1996 Atlanta Olympics bronze medalist, four-time European champion, seven-time European vice-champion, world vice-champion and four-time world bronze medalist. Sevdalin is also a world champion for juniors from Varna in 1992 and second in the world a year later. He is a four-time European Junior Champion from Varna 1991, Cardiff 1992, Valencia 1993 and Rome 1994. Sevdalin Minchev was a athletes & competitors from Gorna Oryahovitsa (b. 1974-07-25, Gorna Oryahovitsa). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
